references.text: The same command to love the Lord your God with all your heart and all your soul is repeated here, which is the core of the Shema prayer.
Moses repeats the requirement to love God, serve him with all your heart and soul, and keep his commands.
The same expression is used regarding following the Lord, fearing him, keeping his commands, listening to his voice, and serving him.
Repeats the command to love the Lord your God, walk in his ways, and keep his commands.
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord their God and serve him with all their heart and all their soul.
The promise of blessing conditioned on obedience to God's commands, including rain at the right time.
The blessings that come from listening to the Lord's voice and keeping all his commands.
Jesus quotes the greatest commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.
Jesus repeats the command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength.
A lawyer quotes the command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind.
